description: This file defines actions related to locking and unlocking elements within the Excalidraw application, including toggling lock state and unlocking all elements.

methods.name: shouldLock
methods.description: Determines if the selected elements should be locked (all unlocked).

methods.name: actionToggleElementLock
methods.description: Action to toggle lock state of selected elements, including updating app state and UI icons.

methods.name: actionUnlockAllElements
methods.description: Action to unlock all currently locked elements.
